<thought>Based on the retrosynthetic disconnection of the flavanone (product of an intramolecular Michael addition of a 2‑hydroxy‑chalcone), the logical precursors are the phenolic fragment that supplies the new ether oxygen and the α,β‑unsaturated carbonyl fragment that supplies the new C‑C bond. The corresponding SMILES are: phenol c1ccc(O)cc1 and the chalcone‑type enone O=C(C=Cc1ccccc1)c2ccccc2. This yields a single viable precursor combination.</thought>
<final_answer>[[\"c1ccc(O)cc1\", \"O=C(C=Cc1ccccc1)c2ccccc2\"]]</final_answer>
